what_it_shows: Wide shot of a 2000s builder-grade master bath: white drop-in whirlpool/garden tub with deck under a window (~45-70% of width), framed chrome/glass shower stall door on the right (~65-100%), vanity sink at far left, beige tile floor.
Same house: angled close view of the built-in white acrylic whirlpool tub with deck, chrome faucet and visible jets, window above, beige tile floor; staged with towel/orchid. Tub fills center.
Front-on close-up of a white jetted/whirlpool tub interior with multiple jets and drain clearly visible, chrome handheld faucet, frosted window band with black frames behind. Tub centered.

Portrait: built-in white acrylic jacuzzi seen from above, many jets visible, still water, wood-plank deck/apron, pebble-panel and grey tile walls; dated 2000s motel/spa-suite look, empty. Tub fills lower 2/3.

Same 2000s master bath: framed clear-glass shower stall with chrome frame (left ~0-32% of width), corner of whirlpool tub at bottom-left, long almond counter with dark wood cabinets (right ~45-100%), beige tile floor.
Portrait: ordinary white-tile shower with plastic curtain pulled aside and running handheld chrome shower; dim, moody light with sun streaks; tired/plain existing shower look.
